description: A chapter with something coming up AND a history behind it, showing the order the two blocks take on one page: Upcoming Events in London first, Recent events in London beneath it. This state cannot be produced from the committed content, because every event in the repo has already passed — which is exactly why it needs a seed. Without it, the upcoming block on a chapter route has no frame proving it renders at all, and a regression there would stay invisible until someone published a future event. The chapter is seeded without a hero photo so both sections fit the capture; a full-bleed hero is a whole viewport tall and would show neither.
